Six-person saunas here start at $6,499. Standard delivery is free to the lower 48 with no minimum, and it is curbside drop-off — the cabin is left at the kerb and getting it to the pad is yours. That is the cost most buyers miss at this size. Inside delivery to the room of your choice is $600, and $1,800 covers that plus unboxing and full assembly, all in.

What changes at six seats

Capacity claims at this size describe bench length, not comfort. A cabin rated for six seats six adults upright, shoulder to shoulder; if you want anyone to lie down, read the interior bench dimensions rather than the headline number. Both Canadian hemlock and western red cedar appear at this size, and cedar carries a price premium for its scent and moisture resistance rather than for any performance difference you will feel.

Electrical, and why you have to check the model

The units here that publish an electrical requirement are split roughly evenly between a standard 120V outlet and a dedicated 240V circuit. There is no rule of thumb by size that will save you the check. Confirm the requirement on the specific model before you buy, and get an electrician's quote before you commit, because a 240V run to a garage or basement is frequently the second-largest line on the invoice.

If six is more than you need, the two-person infrared cabins start considerably lower. For the full range, see all saunas.
